claims.claim: Germany and Austria-Hungary made the first nationwide adoption of daylight saving time on 30 April 1916, to conserve coal during World War I.
claims.episode_span: The first nationwide adoption occurred in Germany and Austria-Hungary on 30 April 1916.
claims.supporting_quote: The first states to adopt DST ( German : Sommerzeit ) nationally were those of the German Empire and its World War I ally Austria-Hungary commencing on 30 April 1916, as a way to conserve coal during wartime.

claims.claim: The Emergency Daylight Saving Time Energy Conservation Act, enacted in December 1973 during the oil crisis, made DST year-round for a trial period beginning January 6, 1974.
claims.episode_span: During the 1973 crisis the new federal rule began on 6 January 1974 and was scheduled to last until the end of the embargo.
claims.source_title: Emergency Daylight Saving Time Energy Conservation Act - Wikipedia
claims.supporting_quote: is a law that made daylight saving time effective year-round for a trial period. [ 1 ] It was intended to decrease energy use during the 1973 oil crisis . This trial period began on January 6, 1974

claims.claim: A Swedish registry study (published 2008) found heart attacks increase by about five percent during the first week after the spring shift to summer time.
claims.episode_span: found a 5 percent increase in incidence during the first week after the spring transition
claims.source_title: Clock-shifts affect risk of heart attack - Karolinska Institutet News
claims.supporting_quote: Scientists at Karolinska Institutet have examined how the incidence of myocardial infarction in Sweden has changed with the summer and winter clock-shifts since 1987. Their results show that the number of heart attacks, on average, increases by about five per cent during the first week of summer time.

claims.claim: A study of two decades of US crash data found the switch to daylight saving time is associated with a 6 percent increase in fatal car crashes in the following week.
claims.episode_span: recorded a 6 to 7 percent rise in fatal crashes on the Monday after spring-forward
claims.source_title: 'Spring forward' to daylight saving time brings surge in fatal car crashes | ScienceDaily
claims.supporting_quote: Fatal car accidents in the United States spike by 6% during the workweek following the "spring forward" to daylight saving time, resulting in about 28 additional deaths each year, according to new University of Colorado Boulder research.

claims.claim: Research on Indiana's statewide adoption of DST found it raised residential electricity use because increased cooling and heating demand outweighed lighting savings.
claims.episode_span: In warm climates the extra hour of evening light increased cooling demand more than it reduced lighting demand.
claims.source_title: Does Daylight Saving Time Conserve Energy? - Scientific American
claims.supporting_quote: Kotchen and his colleague Laura Grant unexpectedly found that daylight time led to a 1 percent overall rise in residential electricity use, costing the state an extra $9 million. Although daylight time reduces demand for household lighting, the researchers suggest that it increased demand for cooling on summer evenings and heating in early spring and late fall mornings.

claims.claim: Russia switched its clocks to permanent standard time on 26 October 2014, after a 2011 decision to stay on year-round daylight saving time.
claims.episode_span: Russia abandoned the practice in 2014 after three years of year-round daylight saving time
claims.supporting_quote: The country changed its clocks to standard time ( UTC+3:00 ) on 26 October 2014, intending to stay there permanently.

claims.claim: In March 2019 the European Parliament approved the proposal to end seasonal clock changes, with implementation deferred to 2021.
claims.episode_span: The European Parliament voted in 2019 to end seasonal clock changes by 2021, though implementation stalled among member states.
claims.supporting_quote: In March 2019, the European Parliament approved the commission's proposal, while deferring implementation from 2019 until 2021.

claims.claim: Arizona (except the Navajo Nation) and Hawaii do not observe daylight saving time.
claims.episode_span: Arizona (except the Navajo Nation) and Hawaii have never observed daylight saving time
claims.supporting_quote: In the United States , Arizona (with the exception of the Navajo Nation), Hawaii , and the five populated territories ( American Samoa , Guam , Puerto Rico , the Northern Mariana Islands , and the US Virgin Islands ) do not participate in daylight saving time.
